criterion: Require feature availability timestamps in inference and batch-training schemas; future-availability perturbation tests must demonstrate no leakage.
test_result: 23 focused tests passed; Ruff, targeted mypy, source inventory and strategy-variant inventory checks passed (619 Python files; 253 candidates). Future availability and revision are rejected.
evidence_scope: Synthetic timestamp and outcome tests; upstream feature timestamp truth and real-market predictive quality are not attested.
operational_limits: Inference requires aware decision, availability, and revision timestamps.
Legacy date-only learned-ranking calls fail closed with no candidate until the caller can provide a valid decision timestamp.
Point-in-time metadata must be supplied accurately by the upstream feature store.
